notes.title: Radiation Rewards: New Steam Items Unlocked!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, survivors!

The radiation is spreading... but this time, it brings something exciting! We’ve just released brand-new Steam community items! 

Collect radioactive trading cards, light up your profile with glowing backgrounds, and unlock emoticons and avatar frames inspired by the post-apocalyptic world.

Jump into the game, embrace the fallout, and start earning these rewards. Thank you for being part of our resilient community!

Best regards,
OneHand Games Team[/h3]
